text: Delighted to be giving an invited talk at SSCU-50, IISc Bengaluru (13–16 December) — the conference celebrating fifty years of the Solid State and Structural Chemistry Unit — in the session on emergent materials for energy and photonics.
Refraction-induced transverse charge transport published in Physical Review B and highlighted as an Editors' Suggestion.
Altermagnetism from the viewpoint of chemistry published in Chemical Society Reviews.
Non-linear Hall effect in metal-organic frameworks posted on arXiv and under review at Physical Review Letters.
Departmental seminars at the Solid State and Structural Chemistry Unit, IISc Bengaluru and the Theoretical Sciences Unit, JNCASR.
Invited as resource person for the one-day national seminar CMQF-2026, Sidho-Kanho-Birsha University, Purulia.
Work on octahedral tilt coupling and spin–orbit reconstruction at oxide interfaces published in Nature Communications.
Origin of flat bands and non-trivial topology in coupled kagome lattices published in Communications Physics.
Received the IOP India Top Cited Paper Award 2025 for Emerging properties of carbon based 2D material beyond graphene.
Academic visit and seminar at the Department of Quantum Matter Physics, University of Geneva.
Joined the Institute for Theoretical Physics and Astrophysics, Universität Würzburg as a postdoctoral researcher within the DFG Cluster of Excellence ct.qmat.
